name: CLAPPING CRUNCHES
introduce: Sit on the floor with your knees bent, feet lifted a little bit and back tilted backwards. Alternately lift your legs and clap under your knees.

tips.text: We suggest that you do this on a mat.
Exhale when you lift your knees, and inhale when you lower them.
To get more of a challenge, keep your leg straight.
If you feel it's too hard, put your feet on the floor.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This primarily targets your abdominal muscles.
